title: News & Insights | Xaira Therapeutics
content: On the Latent Space podcast, Bo Wang and Ci Chu discuss virtual cells, causal biological datasets, and how high-throughput biology advances AI. De Novo Design of Progressable Antibodies to Therapeutic Targets Xaira wins the 2026 Fierce AI Innovation Award for Preclinical Development Curious about Xaira's approach to building better AI for drug discovery? Xaira Therapeutics Announces the Appointment of Dr. Ian McCaffery as SVP, Translational Science and Early Clinical Development, and the Promotions of Dr. Ci Chu to Chief Discovery Officer and Dr. Bo Wang to Chief AI Scientist Up and down the ladder: The latest comings and goings Xaira Therapeutics, Inc. 700 Gateway Blvd, 4th Floor.
